params.body:
The Studio opened inside the writing desk, and nothing told a visitor that a second mode existed for running gentells.com. On production 250 trend proposals were waiting there, unseen.

**A home page with both modes.** The Studio now opens on "Welcome to the Studio, <first name>. Choose where to start." with one card per mode:
- **Write:** where pieces are made, drafts, explorations and posts for gentells.com included. It shows the number of drafts and of pieces in review.
- **Curate:** where you decide what gentells.com shows. It shows posts live, trends live, and the trends waiting for a decision.

The whole card is the choice. The figures come from the same queries as the lists they open.

**The switch in the header.** A two-part control in the middle of the header (Write with a pen, Curate with a globe). The Curate half carries the number of waiting trends, so it is visible from Write as well. The rule under the header takes the colour of the mode: grey on home, crimson in Write, aqua in Curate. Clicking the wordmark returns to the home page.

**Curate gets its own band.** Posts, Trends and Reports sit in an aqua band under the header, on an aqua ground. The header also links to gentells.com itself.

**Waiting trends capped at eight.** The Trends tab shows the strongest eight proposals, with a link to show all of them. Listed in full, they buried the live trends.

Other changes:
- Newsreader, the site's serif (same 60pt cut, 58 KB), is self-hosted for the welcome title.
- The underline tabs get `borderRadius: 0`, so their underline runs straight instead of curving at the ends.

Checked locally with `npm run build` and Playwright screenshots against mocked API responses (home, Write, Curate).
params.title: Studio: open on both modes, Write and Curate
